subject: CGN-LOS - book directly
body:
Dear team,

please quote and book 3 crates of pump spare parts Cologne (CGN) to Lagos (LOS), 410 kg, 1.9 cbm, ready 26.11.2026, delivered to CGN by us. Cheapest option, EUR.

If the all-in price is below EUR 1,500 you need not wait for our confirmation: please book it straight away and send us the booking reference.

Best regards
Marco Lenz
Export
Rheinberg Pumpen AG
